title: Comparison of attention models and post-hoc explanation methods for embryo stage identification: a case study
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion. It benchmarks explanation methods for AI models on an embryo stage identification task, using technical 'faithfulness' metrics from the field of Explainable AI (XAI) which are unrelated to religious faith.
findings: This paper does not analyze, mention, or produce any findings related to religion or faith.
